Automatically added as a dependency - all IGs depend on the HL7 Extension Pack

resource.name: BeAnnex81
resource.description: Annex81 proposal and approval

resource.name: BeFeedbackToPrescriber
resource.description: Whether the prescriber requests feedback on the processing of the order

resource.name: BeGDFullReferralPrescription
resource.description: Specify to include all useful resources around a ServiceRequest that can be retrieved with the $graph operation.

resource.name: BeImagingAttentionConditionsResponse
resource.description: Response to the imaging attention conditions questionnaire. At least one attention condition must be answered.

resource.name: BeLatestEndDate
resource.description: Request must be performed before

resource.name: BeModelAnnex81
resource.description: Logical model describing the model for the Annex81 proposal and approval

resource.name: BeModelAssignment
resource.description: Logical model with the information for the assignment to a referral prescription of a care provider.

resource.name: BeModelNursingPrescription
resource.description: Data model for the nursing prescription referral.

resource.name: BeModelOrganisationClaim
resource.description: Information of a claim of an organisation to have the prescription fulfilled.

resource.name: BeModelReferralPrescription
resource.description: Data model for the prescription referral.

resource.name: BeModelTreatmentStatus
resource.description: Logical model with the information for the status of the treatment.

resource.name: BeNsUhmepShort
resource.description: Naming system identifier for the UHMEP user friendly short code

resource.name: BeOpApproveAnnex81
resource.description: Creates an approval from an Annex81 proposal

resource.name: BeOpRejectAnnex81
resource.description: Rejects an Annex81 proposal

resource.name: BeOrganizationTask
resource.description: Subtask to assign the referral task and prescription to one or more members of this organisation

resource.name: BePerformerTask
resource.description: Subtask performed by one performer

resource.name: BePerformerType
resource.description: Types of performers that can execute this request

resource.name: BePrescriptionStatusReason
resource.description: DEMONSTRATIVE EXAMPLE - Status reason for the prescription. Initially defined as supporting CodeSystem for the referral prescription.

resource.name: BePSSId
resource.description: PSS ID naming system

resource.name: BePSSInfo
resource.description: Information regarding the Prescription Search Support

resource.name: BeReferralServiceRequest
resource.description: The common structure for referral prescription.

resource.name: BeReferralServiceRequestNursing
resource.description: The nursing profile, generic version. Please note the nursing referral for medication does NOT depend on this generic version but is a FHIR prodfile on a different FHIR resource (MedicationRequest)

resource.name: BeReferralTask
resource.description: The task that is referred to in the referral prescription (this is the common task for the execution of the prescription). The subtasks per performer can be found in BePerformerTask

resource.name: BeRelevantInfo
resource.description: Relevant clinical information in the context of this prescription concerning for example allergies, kidney function, diabetic. This extension allows the use of an Annotation or codeableConcept but when more detailed information can be given, it is RECOMMENDED to express it as structured as possible using the appropriate elements.

resource.name: BeServiceRequestDiagnosticImaging
resource.description: The diagnostic imaging profile. Generic version.

resource.name: BeTreatmentStatusReason
resource.description: DEMONSTRATIVE EXAMPLE - Status reason for the treatment. Initially defined as supporting CodeSystem for the referral prescription.

resource.name: BeUnadressedHealthMessageExchangePlatform
resource.description: UHMEP naming system

resource.name: BeUrgencyJustification
resource.description: Justification for the urgency level assigned to the request

resource.name: BeValidityPeriod
resource.description: Begin and end date of the validity of the request

resource.name: BeVSAnnex81StatusReason
resource.description: DEMONSTRATIVE EXAMPLE - Status reason of the Annex 81

resource.name: BeVSPrescriptionStatusReason
resource.description: eReferral reasons for the status of the prescription

resource.name: BeVSRequestIntent
resource.description: eReferral allowed intent codes in the context of referral prescription

resource.name: BeVSTaskIntent
resource.description: DEMONSTRATIVE EXAMPLE - The allowed intent codes in the context of tasks in the field of referral prescriptions

resource.name: BeVSTreatmentStatusReason
resource.description: DEMONSTRATIVE EXAMPLE - Codes for the current status of a treatment in a referral prescription.

resource.name: CodeableConcept Extension for Reference
resource.description: Extension able to hold a coded concept on a Reference element.

resource.name: eReferral Annex 81 Care Requested
resource.description: Clinical care services for Annex 81 prescriptions.

resource.name: eReferral Annex 81 Medical Problem
resource.description: Medical problems/conditions that can justify an Annex 81 request.

resource.name: eReferral Annex 81 Nursing Diagnosis
resource.description: Nursing diagnoses/findings that can motivate an Annex 81 request.

resource.name: eReferral Annex 81 Status Reason
resource.description: DEMONSTRATIVE EXAMPLE - Status reason for the Annex 81

resource.name: eReferral Annex 81 Technical Type
resource.description: Technical type for Annex 81 prescriptions.

resource.name: eReferral Body Site
resource.description: Anatomical body sites based on SNOMED CT for use in referral prescriptions.

resource.name: eReferral Body Topography
resource.description: Topographical qualifiers for body sites based on SNOMED CT.

resource.name: eReferral Categories of Care
resource.description: Categories of care that can be prescribed by a GP in the eReferral project. Currently limited to nursing care.

resource.name: eReferral Diabetes Education Identifier
resource.description: Identifiers to distinguish types of diabetes education prescriptions.

resource.name: eReferral Diabetic Education Type
resource.description: Types of diabetes education activities.

resource.name: eReferral Education Type With Trajectory
resource.description: Types of diabetes education for education within a care trajectory.

resource.name: eReferral Education Type Without Trajectory
resource.description: Types of diabetes education for patients without a trajectory.

resource.name: eReferral Educator Type
resource.description: Types of educators for diabetes education activities.

resource.name: eReferral Generic Care Types
resource.description: Types of care that can be prescribed via the generic prescription.

resource.name: eReferral Glycemia Measurement Time
resource.description: Timing of glycemia measurements.

resource.name: eReferral Glycemia Measurement Timing
resource.description: Timing of glycemia measurements.

resource.name: eReferral Imaging Modality
resource.description: Imaging modality types for prior imaging requests

resource.name: eReferral Imaging Modality ValueSet
resource.description: Allowed modalities for imaging requests.

resource.name: eReferral Imaging Priority
resource.description: Priority codes for diagnostic imaging requests

resource.name: eReferral Imaging Priority ValueSet
resource.description: Allowed priorities for imaging requests.

resource.name: eReferral Implant Type
resource.description: Allowed implant types.

resource.name: eReferral Note Type
resource.description: Types of notes that can be associated with a referral prescription.

resource.name: eReferral Note Types
resource.description: Types of notes that can be associated with a prescription.

resource.name: eReferral Nursing Care Requested
resource.description: Clinical care services that can be prescribed for nursing care using SNOMED CT.

resource.name: eReferral Nursing Prescription Technical Type
resource.description: Technical types of nursing prescriptions for routing and workflow purposes.

resource.name: eReferral Parameter Type
resource.description: Types of parameters/vital signs that can be measured.

resource.name: eReferral Prescription Type
resource.description: Technical types of prescriptions supported by the eReferral system. Used for routing and workflow purposes.

resource.name: eReferral Prescription Type ValueSet
resource.description: Technical types of prescriptions supported by the eReferral system. Used for routing and workflow purposes.

resource.name: eReferral Radiology SupportingInfo Role
resource.description: Indicates the role of a supporting information item in an eReferral for radiology.

resource.name: eReferral Radiology SupportingInfo Role CodeSystem
resource.description: Defines the codes representing the roles of supporting information in an eReferral for radiology.

resource.name: eReferral Radiology SupportingInfo Role ValueSet
resource.description: Defines the set of roles that supporting information can have in an eReferral for radiology.

resource.name: eReferral request track
resource.description: Allowed request tracks. Extends the official Belgian request track value set with UHMEP-specific codes.

resource.name: eReferral Request Track
resource.description: Care setting track codes for diagnostic imaging requests

resource.name: eReferral Sample Substance Type
resource.description: Types of samples/substances that can be collected.

resource.name: eReferral Session Type
resource.description: Types of sessions for education or care activities (standard).

resource.name: eReferral Session Type Extended
resource.description: Types of sessions for education or care activities (extended, including combination).

resource.name: eReferral Session Types
resource.description: Types of sessions for education or care activities.

resource.name: eReferral String Date
resource.description: Date represented as a string. This extension is used to capture date information in a string format when a date must be encrypted.

resource.name: eReferral/PSS Diagnostic Imaging Indication
resource.description: Clinical indications and findings that can support a diagnostic imaging request using SNOMED CT.

resource.name: eReferral/PSS Diagnostic Imaging Procedure
resource.description: Diagnostic care services that can be prescribed for diagnostic imaging using SNOMED CT.

resource.name: Imaging Attention Conditions Questionnaire
resource.description: Questionnaire for capturing attention-worthy conditions relevant to diagnostic imaging requests (implants, pregnancy, diabetes, allergies, etc.)

resource.name: PSS Indication
resource.description: Indication codes for diagnostic imaging requests as PSS Internal Codes.

resource.name: PSS Indication CodeSystem
resource.description: PSS indication codes for diagnostic imaging requests.

resource.name: terminology-expansion
resource.description: Terminology expansion parameters used to include designations.
